message.content: I've reviewed the FY2024 10-K. Key takeaways: revenue $391.0B (+2% yr/yr), gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%), services revenue $96.2B (+13%), operating income $123.2B, operating cash flow $118.3B, and net income $93.7B / diluted EPS $6.08 — the dip in net income is entirely attributable to a one-time $10.2B net State Aid tax charge (24.1% effective rate vs. 14.7%), not operating deterioration. Liquidity is strong ($140.8B cash + marketable securities) alongside $95.0B of buybacks. Risks noted: Greater China sales -8%, DOJ/EU DMA antitrust exposure, and supply-chain concentration. On balance this supports a modest buy within the mandate.
